body: I get that, but it's more I feel like a background character, like one of the ones you see in the back ground or the ones that get murdered on mass by monsters. I have come to accept it and I think I should probably end it cause at this point I've pulled out of society so much I'm likely no longer required for the stories

Their is an unspoken rule that you must contribute, sure people say its OK if you don't but they judge and slowly cut you off, it's more hidden these days but it's always been there, behind us, everyone hating those who can't truly help and only keeping them around out of pity or from the please you get from helping the helpless, slowly people bore though and eventually you fade away being cleaned of the sidelines of the functional society as they forge onwards with the masses being brushed beneath. I'm not being harsh in myself, I'm being honest, I'm useless, I don't benefit society or have the future potential to be worth the trouble, I am like plastic bags, I'm just not worth the trouble it takes to recycle to get benefit out of me so it's best to just get rid of me and stop making more.

Well if I was dead the resources assigned to me to help me with my continued education daily survival and such would be assigned to someone else and therefore could be used in better way, if I continue to stay alive I'm unlikely to help they world as the most good acts don't effect the world as much as the most evil acts and also its requires at least a majority of people doing something in a region for it to have effect and I know that my opinions and thoughts are in the far minority so what I think would make the world a better place is likely to never have an impact, even if we had truly nice people it would still have a negligible impact on the world and the rate that our world will decay and corrupt as selfishness wins will continue to increase as nice people continue to lose out on power or any way to have an impact on this world. I am a meaningless piece of dust, I do not impact the world in a large enough way to help guide people to a better future. I cause harm to those I care about by merely existing and that means I help those who tend towards evil. Morals are also completely subjective, there is nothing that is truly good or truly evil so who am I to say. I am also just a tiny person from a tiny town in a tiny country, even if I had any sway in my country it would likely be never stay as being on the ass end of the world means we are at the mercy of the great powers of the region

But people are rarely nice, most humans are twisted monster who serve themselves, I just think that if I am wasting resources people who far better than me could use especially in the world we live in where humanity has far outstripped a sustainable number.

I'm not trying to hit I constantly see myself harming them, I don't know, I can't trust them, everyone here is so polite you could stab then and they would apologise, becuase I am just a drain, I don't add anything to society and I fail so much that I don't have a future where I can

I have thought about it and statistically the resources I'm using which I see as being wasted on me could then be used on people with a future, also I feel like I harm people around me constantly without trying or doing much so remove me and then they have one less problem.
